note: Twenty-two pages, 44 measured regions: 22 identical page-foot watermark banners and 22 exhibit regions, all of them claimed - twenty numbered figures, Table 1 on p4 and one unnumbered, captionless PCA test plate on p8. The paper prints every figure caption below its art; Table 1's caption is the single above-caption. The text layer is heavily ligated (ﬁ/ﬂ) and every printed quote keeps the ligature. Twelve figures are never cited by number, Figure 11 has no title, and Figure 8's and Figure 10's art fit no schema family, so both are filed as 'other' with an other_note.
rules: Every caption in this paper prints below its art except Table 1, whose caption prints above the grid - [caption.position] is 'below' for all 20 items and 'above' for that one table, matching the printed y of the caption line against the region top.

Figure and table numbers are cited in lowercase throughout ('ﬁgure 6', 'ﬁgure 8', 'fugure 13' - a typo - and 'figure13' with no space), so [mention.style] records the printed form and never a normalised one.
The ligatures ﬁ and ﬂ are used for 'fi' and 'fl' in the text layer; every quote recorded under [mention.style] is reproduced with the ligature so that it stays an exact prefix of the printed line.

Twelve of the twenty figures are never cited by number anywhere in the body (Figures 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11, 12, 18, 19 and 20); their rows carry [mention.count] 0 rather than a guess at a nearby sentence.

The PCA test plate on p8 is a drawn table with no caption, no number and no printed header row, counted as a table with an empty caption and caption_source 'none'; [table.rule_style] is 'booktabs' on its top and bottom rules alone.
Figure 11 is the only exhibit in the paper whose [caption.numbering] is a bare number ('Figure 11') with no title.

Figures 1 and 2 are two panels printed side by side on p5 and their captions are merged into one printed line; they are counted as two exhibits because [geometry.panel_count] is 1 for each and the extractor measured two regions.

Every non-banner region measured in this paper carries an exhibit, so the exclusion set is exactly the 22 page-foot watermark banners and no [place.section_path] row is left without a measured region.
Where no schema family fits the art (the overlap-arc diagram of Figure 8 and the radar pairs of Figure 10) [geometry.family] is 'other' with an other_note naming what is drawn.

caption.verbatim: Table 1: Notations

mention.lead_sentence: The primary notations used in this paper are listed in Table 1.

tables.note: Two columns and five body rows: the notation and its English gloss (MI / Music Influence; sim / The cosine similarity of two vectors; G / The sphere that represent a genre; u / The dominant genre of a particular year which is unknown; Fi / One of the factors drawn from PCA). Booktabs - top rule, header rule, bottom rule, no vertical rule, no box, no zebra, no merged cell, no note under the grid. The caption prints ABOVE the grid (y630.9 against region top y647.3). No numeric column at all, so precision is not applicable. Printed defects: 'the sphere that represent a genre' (number disagreement) and the Fi subscript is flattened to 'Fi' by the text layer.

Captionless, headerless two-column test plate printed in the middle of §3.4 as the PCA acceptance test: KMO Value 0.782; Barlett's Test of Sphericity, Approx.Chi-Square 22406.735; df 78; Sig. 0.000. Four printed rows in all (KMO Value / 0.782, then the three Bartlett statistic rows) and no printed header row, so the numeric column is unlabelled - the KMO row occupies the header slot only because the record contract needs header_rows >= 1, leaving three body rows. Booktabs: top rule, bottom rule, no header rule, no vertical rule, no zebra; the 'Barlett's Test of Sphericity' label spans the three statistic rows, recorded as a merged cell. Values are right-aligned, not decimal-aligned. Printed defects: 'Barlett's' for Bartlett's and the missing space in 'Approx.Chi-Square'. The paper never numbers or cites this plate.
